This section showcases interactive visualizations generated with Python and Plotly.

## 3D Scatter Plot Example

Here is an example of clustering visualization. You can zoom, rotate, and hover over points.

```{python}
#| label: fig-3d
#| fig-cap: "Interactive 3D Iris Dataset"

import plotly.express as px

# On utilise un jeu de données d'exemple inclus dans Plotly
df = px.data.iris()

# Création du graphique 3D
fig = px.scatter_3d(df, x='sepal_length', y='sepal_width', z='petal_width',
              color='species',
              symbol='species',
              opacity=0.7,
              size_max=10)

# Affichage (Quarto va transformer ça en HTML interactif)
fig.show()
```
